text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-\n1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.\n2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The note specifies the hardness (24-32 HRC) but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment applies (e.g., before or after machining, before surface treatment). Without a defined sequence, the supplier may apply it at the wrong time, causing distortion of finished features or preventing proper machining. The designer should add the process stage to the heat treatment callout in N1.","recommended_correction":"Update N1 to specify when the toughening is performed relative to machining and surface treatment (e.g., 'TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING AND BEFORE FINAL MACHINING')."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D24","page":1,"quote":"⌀8   H7 THRU`"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀8 H7 through hole (D24) is a tight-tolerance fit feature on a part that receives zinc plating (I.Z.B.P.), yet no allowance for plating thickness is indicated. Plating buildup inside the bore will reduce its effective diameter and can cause mating pins or fasteners to fail to assemble. The designer should either specify that the H7 tolerance applies after plating, provide an oversized pre-plate dimension, or add a note masking the hole during plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note or modify D24 to account for plating thickness on the H7 bore, such as specifying the pre-plate size or stating 'H7 AFTER PLATING'."}]}
